Suppose $Y$ is a continuous random variable. We wish to conduct a hypothesis test with the following null and alternative hypotheses:

- $H_{0}$: $Y∼N(10, (\sqrt{10})^{2})$
- $H_{1}$: $Y≁N(10, (\sqrt{10})^{2})$

A random sample is carried out, and the sample data is shown below. The third column gives $P(a < Y < b)$ under the null hypothesis, where $a$ and $b$ are the boundaries for each class of observations.

Calculate the expected frequency $E_{i}$ for each class of observations. Round each answer to **one decimal place.**

| Observations $(y_{i})$ | Frequency $(O_{i})$ | $P(a < Y < b)$ | $E_{i}$ |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| $0 \le y_{i} < 4$ | $8$ | $0.0281$ | {{field-1}} |
| $4 \le y_{i} < 8$ | $34$ | $0.2347$ | {{field-2}} |
| $8 \le y_{i} < 12$ | $99$ | $0.4729$ | {{field-3}} |
| $12 \le y_{i} < 16$ | $29$ | $0.2347$ | {{field-4}} |
| $16 \le y_{i} < 20$ | $10$ | $0.0281$ | {{field-5}} |

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
